📄 Payment Schedule Preview
🖨️ Print Server

Turn this ON only on the computer that has the printer connected. Other devices can then choose "Main PC" from any Print button — installment slips, invoices, checkout receipts — instead of printing locally, and this device will pick up and print those jobs automatically.

For truly hands-free printing (no click needed on this PC), Chrome needs to be launched with a special flag — a one-time setup step outside this app. Without it, this will still auto-detect jobs and open the print dialog automatically, just needs one click to confirm.

🔢 Bill No. Format

Prefix is printed exactly as typed — no padding is added. Track B always mirrors Track A's last bill number + 1 (it can repeat until Track A issues a new bill).

Edit this any time to resume the sequence from a specific number.

☁️ Auto Backup to Drive

Connect the local folder that Google Drive Desktop syncs to your Drive. This app writes one backup file into it — each write replaces the last, and Drive uploads it automatically. Works only while this app is open, so it also catches up any missed time as soon as the shop opens.
